title: Rota: the supervisor's week planner
question: Three ways to lay out the week, each with every day as a 15-minute timeline: shifts first, bookings inside them, and every gap highlighted. The visual style stays Poolside Clear. Pick the layout to build, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: The week, stacked
options.lineage: A departure board: every day of the week on one screen, each a timeline row.
options.thesis: All seven days on one screen as stacked 15-minute timelines; open one day in place to plan it.
options.viewport: Toolbar (week, department, Add booking). Below, Monday to Sunday, each a compact timeline of its bookings, with a thin coverage ribbon under it: blue where covered, amber where short, red where someone is off or unqualified. The open day expands in place into lanes: bookings and fixed cover on top, each person's shift underneath. Drag across a lane to add a booking; drop people on its empty slots.
options.risk: Seven rows plus one open day is dense; a big department makes the open day long.

regions.label: Mon, open: bookings & cover lanes, then each person's shift (15-min grid)

options.label: Needs over people
options.lineage: A stage manager's call sheet: what the show needs, and who is in the building.
options.thesis: One day at a time, split in two: what needs people on top, who is on shift below, and a shortfall bar between them.
options.viewport: Toolbar, then day tabs Mon to Sun, each counting its gaps. Top half: bookings and fixed cover, each a lane showing 'needs 2 · has 1' along its time. A 15-minute shortfall bar runs across the middle like a level meter. Bottom half: each person's shift. Drag a person's shift up onto a booking to assign them. A Needs you list on the right names every gap in time order.
options.risk: Planning a whole week means stepping through seven tabs; the week shape is only in the tab counts.

regions.label: Mon 3 · Tue · Wed 1 · Thu · Fri · Sat 2 · Sun
What needs people: bookings & fixed cover (needs vs has)
Who is on: each person's shift
Needs you: every gap, in time order

options.label: Coverage map first
options.lineage: A weather radar for the week: see where the storms are, then zoom in.
options.thesis: The week as a heat map of 15-minute cells; click a shortfall to fix it beside that day's lanes.
options.viewport: Toolbar, then a heat map: seven day rows, every 15 minutes a cell, quiet blue where covered, amber where short, red where off or unqualified. Click a cell or drag a stretch: below, the left panel says what is short then and lists who is free and qualified, one click to assign; the right shows that day's lanes, bookings over shifts, where you also drag to add a booking.
options.risk: The map shows problems well, but bookings themselves are only legible in the day below.

regions.label: Week heat map: 7 days × 15-min cells (covered · short · off)
Fix: what is short, who is free & qualified
